BiblicalUsage: ʻÊrân was an Ephraimite, a son of Shuthelah. The name occurs once, in Numbers. The fuller story lives on the People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻÊrân is worth noticing precisely because so little is said — the record kept the name anyway. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
